detail.failure: A nested template literal inside the generated X2 core prematurely closed the outer builder template and produced a syntax error.

detail.recovery: Replace only the nested display-string interpolation with plain concatenation and rerun the non-executing vm.Script parse before execution.

detail.failure: The separately structured basic-word oracle compared ordered prefixes with canonically sorted feasible sets and returned an empty oracle family for CG01.

detail.recovery: Preserve ordered complete-envelope comparisons, add a separate set-equality predicate only for feasible-prefix membership, remove the one partial generated core, and rerun from the frozen X1 parent.

detail.failure: Deletion-minor construction reached the generated core before that core defined its local finite subset enumerator.

detail.recovery: Add the missing bounded subset enumerator to the generated core, remove the one partial core, and rerun from the unchanged X1 head.
